root_cause_analysis.symptom: MCP tool call fails with 'endpoint connection error'; sidebar doesn't update; tool block hidden
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The STDIO bridge (happyMcpStdioBridge.ts) uses StreamableHTTPClientTransport to connect to the HTTP MCP server (startHappyServer.ts), but this connection fails. The HTTP server uses StreamableHTTPServerTransport with stateless mode (sessionIdGenerator: undefined). The bridge creates a new Client + StreamableHTTPClientTransport on first tool call (lazy init via ensureHttpClient). The connection error suggests the HTTP transport handshake between client and server fails -- likely an MCP SDK version incompatibility or the StreamableHTTP transport not properly handling stateless mode. The sidebar not updating is a secondary symptom: the internal handler (Path B) DOES update metadata via updateMetadata(), which broadcasts via WebSocket. The sidebar SHOULD update -- if it doesn't, it's because the app client is not receiving or processing the update-session event for the metadata change.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 0fd4112f - fix: MCP server broken by SDK 1.27 transport reuse rejection
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The MCP SDK 1.27 changed transport behavior, rejecting reuse of already-connected transports. The fix switched to stateless StreamableHTTP (sessionIdGenerator: undefined) for the HTTP server, but the bridge client may not be compatible with this stateless mode.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The StreamableHTTPClientTransport may expect a session-based server and fail when connecting to a stateless one. The bridge's lazy initialization (ensureHttpClient) means the first tool call bears the full connection overhead, and any failure there makes the tool permanently unavailable for that session.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Introduced around commit 0fd4112f (2026-03-26) when fixing SDK 1.27 transport reuse. The STDIO bridge architecture has been problematic since its introduction.

file_contents.happyMcpStdioBridge.ts: STDIO MCP server that forwards change_title to HTTP MCP server via StreamableHTTPClientTransport. Lazy-inits HTTP client on first call. Receives HTTP URL via --url flag.
file_contents.runClaude.ts:530-536: MCP config: type='stdio', command='node', args=['happyMcpStdioBridge.mjs', '--url', happyServer.url]. Passed to Claude SDK as mcpServers config.
file_contents.apiSession.ts:413-424: sendClaudeSessionMessage handles summary type messages by updating metadata with {text, updatedAt}. This is called from persistTitle in startHappyServer.ts.
file_contents.sessionUpdateHandler.ts:58-69: Server broadcasts update-session with metadata after successful update-metadata. Uses eventRouter.emitUpdate with recipientFilter: all-interested-in-session.
file_contents.sync.ts:1900-1935: App processes update-session by decrypting metadata and calling applySessions(). This updates the session in storage.
file_contents.sessionUtils.ts:80-82: getSessionName() returns metadata.summary.text if available, otherwise falls back to path last segment.
file_contents.messageToEvent.ts:47-56: Converts mcp__happy__change_title tool-call to event with message 'Title changed to X'. This means the tool call becomes an event instead of rendering as a tool block.

development_approach.strategy: Two-pronged fix: (1) Diagnose and fix the STDIO bridge HTTP connection failure -- likely need to test StreamableHTTPClientTransport against a stateless server, possibly switch to a simpler HTTP fetch approach if SDK transport is incompatible. (2) Verify sidebar updates work end-to-end -- the infrastructure exists (update-metadata -> broadcast -> sync.ts -> applySessions -> getSessionName), so this may already work once the MCP call succeeds. (3) In messageToEvent.ts, the tool call is currently converted to an event which hides the tool block -- either keep it as event (shows 'Title changed' as service message) or remove the conversion to show the tool block.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1. Build CLI, deploy dev daemon, start a session. 2. Ask Claude to change the title. 3. Verify no 'endpoint connection error' in logs. 4. Verify sidebar shows new title within 2s. 5. Verify tool call renders in chat (either as tool block or as service message, depending on design decision).

research_findings.reason: Bug fix with clear root cause from codebase investigation -- StreamableHTTP transport compatibility issue between bridge client and stateless server
